integrity.integral_method: acyclic discrete Morse matching with signed primitive boundary

scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary five-cut complex of the twelve-vertex K3 Cartesian K4 rook graph is classified.
The claim determines additive integral homology, not the complete homotopy type, Steenrod operations, or a uniform family formula.
Uniqueness against all historical or unindexed mathematical literature is not established.
title: Three-degree integral homology at the five-cut threshold of the \(3\times4\) rook graph
